newsitem.title: POLAND: VISCOPLAST UNABLE TO RESUME PRODUCTION.
newsitem.headline: VISCOPLAST UNABLE TO RESUME PRODUCTION.

text.p: Polish chemical firm Viscoplast SA cannot resume production due to the shortage of electricity and water and the need to repair its flooded machinery and equipment, the company said on Monday.
"On July 12 the company's plant was flooded. Raw materials, goods and ready-made products were damaged," it said in a statement.

"Based on inventory levels of June 30, the company made a 4.9 million-zloty provision for expected flood damage, the extent of which is currently difficult to estimate," the company said in a statement. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
